blurb: Legacy with Purpose. Welcome to Johnson Estate, New York’s oldest continuously operating estate winery. Here, wine is more than what we make, it’s what we carry forward. From four generations of family care to a deep respect for the land and the people around us, every bottle is part of a story built on heritage, hospitality, and purpose. Plan Your Visit Legacy with Purpose.
